items.name: Service level agreements
items.explanation: An SLA is an agreed promise about how a service will perform, such as answering within a set time for nearly every request. Dynamo's design starts from one.

assumedBy.quote: A common approach in the industry for forming a performance oriented SLA is to describe it using average, median and expected variance.

sources.title: Service Level Objectives (Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 4)

items.name: Paxos
items.explanation: A protocol that lets a group of machines agree on one value, even when some fail. Spanner runs one group per slice of data.

assumedBy.quote: To support replication, each spanserver implements a single Paxos state machine on top of each tablet.

items.name: Two-phase commit
items.explanation: A way to make several parts of a system commit one change together: first all agree they can, then all do it.

assumedBy.quote: Running two-phase commit over Paxos mitigates the availability problems.
